title: MOJO – A Swingin’ Christmas
seo_title: MOJO – A Swingin' Christmas at Gillioz Theatre
description: The Missouri Jazz Orchestra (MOJO) performs a night of swinging Christmas music, with guest vocalists, audience sing-alongs, and possibly a visit from a red-suited cat. Tickets are general admission, and no outside food or drink is allowed in the theatre. It takes place Saturday, November 28, 2026, with doors at 6:30 PM and the show at 7:30 PM, at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central, E Springfield, Missouri.
